# scoop-bucket

Scoop bucket for FRANORDE’s apps

## Installation

```
scoop bucket add franorde https://github.com/FRANORDE/scoop-bucket
scoop install <app-name>
```

### Notes

`scoop update` isn't needed right after adding the bucket. Run it later to get new versions of the apps.
Replace `<app-name>` with the app you want to install

## Apps

| App | Description |
|---|---|
| [waver](https://github.com/FRANORDE/WaveR) | A simple, cozy local music player |
